passages.text: When the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers, singers, and Levites were appointed.
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah led the people of Jerusalem.
They rebuilt the wall around the city.
They finished building the wall.
Nehemiah put the doors in place.
He appointed the gatekeepers.
He appointed the singers.
He appointed the Levites.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֔ה וָאַעֲמִ֖יד הַדְּלָת֑וֹת וַיִּפָּֽקְד֛וּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: Then I put my brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem, along with Hananiah the commander of the fortress, because he was a faithful man who feared God more than most.
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the leader of the people in Jerusalem.
He needed trustworthy leaders for the city.
He appointed his brother Hanani to be in charge of Jerusalem.
He also appointed Hananiah, the commander of the fortress, to help lead Jerusalem.
Hananiah was a faithful man.
Hananiah feared God more than most people.
passages.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת־ חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗י וְאֶת־ חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַבִּירָ֖ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּי־ הוּא֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְיָרֵ֥א אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: And I told them, “Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot. While the guards are on duty, keep the doors shut and securely fastened. And appoint the residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some at their own homes.”
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the governor of Jerusalem.
He gave instructions to the leaders and gatekeepers.
He said, “Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot.
Keep the gates closed early in the morning.
Wait until the day is well advanced before opening them.
While the guards are still on duty, keep the doors shut and securely fastened.
Appoint guards from among the residents of Jerusalem.
Assign each man to his post.
Assign each man to stand guard near his own house.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עַד־ חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָת֖וֹת וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָר֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now the city was large and spacious, but there were few people in it, and the houses had not yet been rebuilt.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem was a large city.
The city had wide open spaces.
Few people lived in Jerusalem.
No houses had been rebuilt in the city.
passages.original: וְהָעִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֙יִם֙ וּגְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהָעָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ וְאֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם׃

passages.text: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials, and the people to be enrolled by genealogy. I found the genealogical register of those who had first returned, and I found the following written in it: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles carried away to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar its king. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town, accompanied by Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. This is the count of the men of Israel: the descendants of Parosh, 2,172; the descendants of Shephatiah, 372; the descendants of Arah, 652; the descendants of Pahath-moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab), 2,818; the descendants of Elam, 1,254; the descendants of Zattu, 845; the descendants of Zaccai, 760; the descendants of Binnui, 648; the descendants of Bebai, 628; the descendants of Azgad, 2,322; the descendants of Adonikam, 667; the descendants of Bigvai, 2,067; the descendants of Adin, 655; the descendants of Ater (through Hezekiah), 98; the descendants of Hashum, 328; the descendants of Bezai, 324; the descendants of Hariph, 112; the descendants of Gibeon, 95; the men of Bethlehem and Netophah, 188; the men of Anathoth, 128; the men of Beth-azmaveth, 42; the men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, 743; the men of Ramah and Geba, 621; the men of Michmash, 122; the men of Bethel and Ai, 123; the men of the other Nebo, 52; the descendants of the other Elam, 1,254; the descendants of Harim, 320; the men of Jericho, 345; the men of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, 721; and the descendants of Senaah, 3,930.
passages.sermon:
God put a thought into my heart.
God told me to gather the nobles, the officials, and the people.
God wanted them to be enrolled by genealogy.
I found the genealogical record of those who had returned first.
I read what was written in the record.
These are the people of the province.
They came up from captivity in Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, had taken them away.
They returned to Jerusalem and Judah.
Each person went to his own town.
These people came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah.

passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַי֙ אֶל־ לִבִּ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֞ה אֶת־ הַחֹרִ֧ים וְאֶת־ הַסְּגָנִ֛ים וְאֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽאֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַיַּ֙חַשׂ֙ הָעוֹלִ֣ים בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֔ה וָאֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בּֽוֹ׃פ אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְלִיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃ הַבָּאִ֣ים עִם־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵֽי־ פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִבְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְיוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ס בְּנֵ֣י בִנּ֔וּי שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס בְּנֵֽי־ אָטֵ֥ר לְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔יף מֵאָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ס בְּנֵ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְטֹפָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵית־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּבְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וָגָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־ אֵל֙ וְהָעָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְב֛וֹ אַחֵ֖ר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס בְּנֵי־ לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְאוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ס בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃פ

passages.text: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah (through the house of Jeshua), 973; the descendants of Immer, 1,052; the descendants of Pashhur, 1,247; and the descendants of Harim, 1,017.
passages.sermon:
The priests returned from exile in Babylon.
The priests included the descendants of Jedaiah from the house of Jeshua.
There were 973 descendants of Jedaiah from the house of Jeshua.
The priests also included the descendants of Immer.
There were 1,052 descendants of Immer.
The priests also included the descendants of Pashhur.
There were 1,247 descendants of Pashhur.
The priests also included the descendants of Harim.
There were 1,017 descendants of Harim.
passages.original: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃פ

passages.text: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua (through Kadmiel, through the line of Hodevah ), 74.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a group of Israelites.
They served in the temple.
Some Levites were descendants of Jeshua.
These descendants came through Kadmiel.
They also came through the line of Hodevah.
There were seventy-four of these Levites.

passages.text: The singers: the descendants of Asaph, 148.
passages.sermon: The singers served in the temple.\r\nThey came from the family of Asaph.\r\nThere were 148 singers from this family.

passages.text: The gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, the descendants of Ater, the descendants of Talmon, the descendants of Akkub, the descendants of Hatita, and the descendants of Shobai, 138 in all.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers served in the temple.
They came from six families.
The first family was the descendants of Shallum.
The second family was the descendants of Ater.
The third family was the descendants of Talmon.
The fourth family was the descendants of Akkub.
The fifth family was the descendants of Hatita.
The sixth family was the descendants of Shobai.
There were 138 gatekeepers in total.

The descendants of Neziah were temple servants.
The descendants of Hatipha were temple servants.
passages.original: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־ צִחָ֥א בְנֵי־ חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃ בְּנֵי־ קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי־ סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃ בְּנֵי־ לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־ חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי׃ בְּנֵי־ חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי־ גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי־ גָֽחַר׃ בְּנֵי־ רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־ רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקוֹדָֽא׃ בְּנֵי־ גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי־ עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ׃ בְּנֵי־ בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי־ מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י נְפוּשְׁסִים׃ בְּנֵי־ בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי־ חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃ בְּנֵי־ בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי־ מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃ בְּנֵי־ בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־ סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־ תָֽמַח׃ בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃

passages.text: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Sophereth, the descendants of Perida, the descendants of Jaala, the descendants of Darkon, the descendants of Giddel, the descendants of Shephatiah, the descendants of Hattil, the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim, and the descendants of Amon.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of the servants of Solomon are listed here.
They include the descendants of Sotai.
They include the descendants of Sophereth.
They include the descendants of Perida.
They include the descendants of Jaala.
They include the descendants of Darkon.
They include the descendants of Giddel.
They include the descendants of Shephatiah.
They include the descendants of Hattil.
They include the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim.
They include the descendants of Amon.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־ סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־ סוֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃ בְּנֵי־ יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי־ דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃ בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־ חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 in all.
passages.sermon: The temple servants were special workers for the temple.\r\nThe descendants of the servants of Solomon were also special workers.\r\nAll the temple servants and the descendants of Solomon’s servants together numbered 392.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: The following came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer, but could not prove that their families were descended from Israel: the descendants of Delaiah, the descendants of Tobiah, and the descendants of Nekoda, 642 in all.
passages.sermon:
Some people returned from exile.
They came from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer.
These people could not prove their family history.
They could not show that their families were from Israel.
These groups included the descendants of Delaiah.
They also included the descendants of Tobiah.
They also included the descendants of Nekoda.
There were 642 people in total.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעוֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְאִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־ אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃ בְּנֵי־ דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

passages.text: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, the descendants of Hakkoz, and the descendants of Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).
passages.sermon:
Some of the people were priests.
These priests included the descendants of Hobaiah.
They also included the descendants of Hakkoz.
They also included the descendants of Barzillai.
This Barzillai had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite.
He took her as his wife.
He was called by the name of Barzillai.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־ שְׁמָֽם׃

passages.text: These men searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
passages.sermon:
These men belonged to families of priests.
They searched for their family records.
They wanted to prove their ancestry.
They could not find their records.
The leaders excluded them from the priesthood.
They were considered unclean.
passages.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃

passages.text: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
passages.sermon:
The governor spoke to these men.
These men were priests who could not prove their family records.
The governor gave them a command.
He told them not to eat the most holy things.
They must wait.
They could eat only after a priest stood to consult the Urim and Thummim.
The Urim and Thummim were sacred objects used to seek God's will.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתוּמִּֽים׃

passages.text: The whole assembly numbered 42,360, in addition to their 7,337 menservants and maidservants, as well as their 245 male and female singers.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel returned from exile.
They gathered together as one group.
The whole assembly had 42,360 people.
They also had 7,337 menservants and maidservants.
They had 245 male singers and female singers.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: They had 736 horses, 245 mules, 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel returned from exile.
They brought many animals with them.
They had 736 horses.
They had 245 mules.
They had 435 camels.
They had 6,720 donkeys.
passages.original: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑הס חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

passages.text: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the project. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold, 50 bowls, and 530 priestly garments.
passages.sermon:
Some of the heads of the families gave gifts for the work.
The governor led the people.
The governor gave gifts to the treasury.
He gave 1,000 darics of gold.
He gave 50 bowls.
He gave 530 priestly garments.
passages.original: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the project 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
passages.sermon:
Some of the heads of the families gave gifts.
They gave these gifts for the project.
They gave 20,000 darics of gold.
They also gave 2,200 minas of silver.
They put these gifts into the treasury.
passages.original: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The rest of the people gave a total of 20,000 darics of gold, 2,000 minas of silver, and 67 priestly garments.
passages.sermon:
The rest of the people gave offerings.
They gave 20,000 darics of gold.
They gave 2,000 minas of silver.
They gave 67 priestly garments.
passages.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ

passages.text: So the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, and temple servants, along with some of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. And by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in their towns.
passages.sermon:
The priests settled in their own towns.
The Levites settled in their own towns.
The gatekeepers settled in their own towns.
The singers settled in their own towns.
The temple servants settled in their own towns.
Some of the people settled in their own towns.
All the Israelites settled in their own towns.
The seventh month arrived.
The Israelites were living in their towns.
passages.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־ הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃
